text:
jo (Partnerships): Team update — Cascade Data accepted our connector into their ISV marketplace listing and will offer Redwood as an optional managed inference addon. Pilot kickoff scheduled next week :tada:

harry (Sales): Nice! Any committed volume or ARR signal?

jo (Partnerships): Pilot: 60 days, 30 customer clusters across three enterprise accounts. Billing is consumption + small integration fee. Upside to Dedicated if >100 clusters.

yasmin (Marketing): We'll want a short partner blurb + a simple diagram. Can we capture a 1-line quote at kickoff? Prefer to hold an external post until week-2 telemetry.

omar (Solutions): Cascade wants a sample Helm chart values and a note about resource sizing for the sidecar agent. Also they requested SAML SSO guidance and token rotation docs.

luke (Engineering): Quick Helm snippet to share:
```
helm repo add redwood https://charts.redwood.ai
helm install redwood-connector redwood/connector \
  --namespace redwood --set connector.apiKey="<REDACTED>" \
  --set agent.resources.requests.cpu="300m" \
  --set agent.resources.requests.memory="384Mi"
```
Agent health is on port 8443; outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443 required. Will drop a values.yaml in the private channel.

cascade-ci-bot: marketplace bundle validation 2026-02-28T15:02:12Z - PASS (sha: b7e4c9d)

yasmin (Marketing): Great — I'll draft the blurb. Suggested copy: "Cascade Data and Redwood Inference bring turnkey, secure LLM inference to managed clusters via a lightweight connector." Thoughts?

j o (Partnerships): tiny nit: "LLM inference" > "LLM inference" (no change) — looks good. Also add "SSO & token rotation supported" if space allows.

harry (Sales): Marked CRM opp as "ISV Marketplace Pilot - Cascade" and tagged AE for renewal strategy. Adding expansion trigger at 50+ clusters.

omar (Solutions): Next steps: (1) luke: values.yaml + token rotation example by EOD, (2) yasmin: partner blurb + one-pager draft, (3) jo: create private `#cascade-integration` channel and invite vendor contacts.

jo (Partnerships): Private channel `#cascade-integration` created and vendor invited. Kicked off calendar invite for pilot onboarding. Thanks team! :rocket:
